title: -(으)ㄹ 수 없어요
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The Korean Basic Dictionary defines **-(으)ㄹ 수 없다** (usually written **-ㄹ(을) 수 없다**) as indicating that something is not possible and gives examples such as **들을 수 없다**, **말할 수 없다**, and **물건을 들 수 없었다**. An NIKL report classifies **-(으)ㄹ 수 없다** as impossibility/capacity modality, separately from prohibition markers such as **-면 안 되다**. Thus “no se puede” can express inability or impossibility in context; the construction alone does not establish a rule-based prohibition.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona directamente con **-(으)ㄹ 수 있다**, su contraparte afirmativa. Se distingue de **-아/어도 되다**, que expresa permiso, y de **-(으)면 안 되다**, que expresa prohibición.
